subject: regional-tamil
title: Tamil — Set 2
description: Common phrases, nature, and question words

questions.question: What does 'சூரியன்' (Suryan) mean?
questions.explanation: 'சூரியன்' means Sun in Tamil. The word is related to Sanskrit 'सूर्य'.

questions.question: What does 'மழை' (Mazhai) mean?
questions.explanation: 'மழை' means rain in Tamil. Tamil Nadu's monsoon is called 'மழைக்காலம்'.

questions.question: What does 'நண்பன்' (Nanban) mean?
questions.explanation: 'நண்பன்' means friend (male) in Tamil. 'நண்பி' is used for female friend.

questions.question: How do you say 'two' in Tamil?
What does 'என் பெயர்' (En peyar) mean?
questions.explanation: 'என் பெயர்' means 'my name'. Full sentence: 'என் பெயர் ___' = My name is ___.

questions.question: What does 'நிலா' (Nila) mean?
questions.explanation: 'நிலா' means Moon in Tamil. It is also a popular Tamil name for girls.

questions.question: What does 'என்ன' (Enna) mean?
questions.explanation: 'என்ன' means What in Tamil. It is one of the most useful question words.

questions.question: Tamil is one of the world's oldest languages. How many years old is it (approximately)?
questions.explanation: Tamil is over 2,000 years old and is considered a classical language of India. It is one of the longest-surviving classical languages in the world.
